objects.title: The Start
objects.text:
Life has been getting worse for a long time now...

Not all at once, but quietly.

The kind of bad that seeps in between days and settles there.

Things that once mattered feel so distant, like they never were even yours to begin with...

You wake up tired, even after sleep.

You move through the world with the sense that something is missing, though you can’t name what it is.

At first, you tell yourself it’s normal.

Everyone goes through phases.

But the feeling doesn’t pass. It grows...

Small things start going wrong for no clear reason.

Moments of calm never last. Every time you think you’ve steadied yourself, something unseen pushes back, just enough to remind you not to get comfortable. You couldn't take it all anymore... You could no longer be strong, You broke under the pressure. Life will not let you have your happiness back. You cannot handle this pain It hurt so much...

objects.title: Loss
objects.text:
Someone you held closer than reason was taken by death’s indifferent hand. One day they were there.

Then they were not... Your life started falling apart, Nothing meant anything now that they were gone.. Without them, you slowly stopped caring what became of you.

objects.title: Illness
objects.text: A sickness took root within you. It gnawed at your strength, your independence, your dignity until you were a pathetic husk of your former self. Day by day, your body betrayed you in small, humiliating ways. You learned to live inside a body that could no longer be trusted.

objects.title: Betrayal
objects.text: You placed your trust in someone who used that very trust as a tool for their gain. They took what they needed, then ditched you like an animal when you outlived your usefulness with no shame. Since then, You are afraid of getting close to other people, You can no longer trust anyone besides yourself.

objects.title: Failure
objects.text:
You suffered a shameful failure.

That was a moment your life was supposed to turn upward, a vital event... Whatever the goal was, you missed it completely, and the miss was unforgettable. The failure lingered, following you through conversations and quiet judgments. Your name became attached to that failure.

objects.title: Stolen
objects.text:
Something you poured yourself into was taken from you. Your work, your effort, your ideas repackaged under another name. They were praised while you were ignored. When you tried to speak, no one listened.

You learned that hard work does not always belong to the one who does it.

rows.title: The Fracture
rows.titleText:
The moment from which all the other misfortunes spread. The harbinger of the pain, The singular event that broke you apart. A quiet omen of the ruin to come.

What fractured your life?

objects.title: Denial
objects.text:
You acted like nothing had changed. You kept showing up, smiling, doing what was expected of you. If anyone asked, you were fine.

Ignoring all the pain shoved deep inside. The performance was real convincing, even fooling yourself. What you didn’t admit couldn’t be addressed.

objects.title: Indulgence
objects.text: You couldn’t handle it on your own. So you looked for something that would make it easier, even for a little while. Drugs, alcohol, anything that took the edge off and made the days blur together. It didn’t fix anything, but it gave you a break from feeling it. That was enough to keep going.

objects.title: Isolation
objects.text:
You retreated back from everything. Less talking. Fewer people. Fewer reasons to leave your comfort space. You kept only what was necessary and let the rest fade away into oblivion.

Being alone felt safer. If nothing really mattered anymore, then it couldn’t hurt you the same way.

objects.title: Overcompensation
objects.text: You didn’t allow yourself to slow down. You worked more. Helped more. Stayed busy whenever possible. Putting more effort into things than needed. As long as there was something demanding your attention, there was no room to think. And if you couldn't think, You wouldn't realize how bad your life actually is...

rows.title: The Response
rows.titleText: What followed the fracture persisted... for a long long time. Reality pressed in, day after day, until it became too much to carry on. You did what you could to keep yourself intact. What was your response?

objects.title: Burnout
objects.text: Something inside you was worn down beyond repair. The emotions you once had no longer come naturally, Joy is foreign, Anger is distant.. What remains is a hollow calm. When chaos erupts, your mind stays clear, unburdened by panic or hesitation.

objects.title: Erosion
objects.text:
You let all your connections degrade away. Messages unanswered, Calls ignored, They all decreased gradually.

Over time, people simply forgot you were ever there to begin with. This lets you operate with complete anonymity with nobody to tie you down.

objects.title: Reckless
objects.text: You take risks others hesitate at. The idea of harm doesn’t stop you the way it should, You no longer care what happens to you. This makes you decisive and bold, Able to call shots in crucial moments with zero doubt but also makes you reckless in ways you don’t always notice.

objects.title: Insomnia
objects.text:
Sleep no longer comes easily to you. Your body may rest, but not your mind. No amount of rest feels complete, as though true sleep has abandoned you.

Still, when circumstances demand it, you can remain awake and functional long after others fail.

rows.title: The Scar
rows.titleText: What you relied on to survive was never meant to last. Over time, your response to the fracture began to take its toll. What scar did your actions leave behind?

objects.title: The Darkness
objects.text:
You continued on with your… existence. It isn’t something that can be called a life anymore.

Day after another, you’re torn apart by a cold, unforgiving world that no longer cares about you.

Eventually, You tune everything out...nothing mattered at all.

With nothing left to anchor you to the human world, you become receptive... An invitation without meaning to be one.

And something answers.

Not something human. Something supernatural.

objects.title: Ancestor
objects.text:
It wears a familiar face, though you cannot place it at first. This spirit once carried your blood, once lived a life that fractured in much the same way yours did.

The Ancestor does not guide you away from ruin. It teaches you how to sink into it properly.

It is not here to save you. It is here to make sure the cycle continues. +0 Spells

+3 Rituals

addons.title: Morningstar
addons.text:
A man, perhaps. Beautiful in a way that feels fake.

His presence pulls at your thoughts, making you unable to look away, making obedience feel natural..

He offers knowledge freely, perhaps the strongest option here, all with a smile that hides his motives.

Under his guidance, no path is forbidden. Ofcourse there is a price to pay.

+2 Spells

+2 Rituals

addons.title: ???
addons.text:
YOU FOOL

YOU FOOL

YOU FOOL

YOU FOOL

YOU FOOL

YOU FOOL YOU FOOL

+2 Spells

+2 Inhumanity

+2 Rituals

objects.title: Grimoire
objects.text:
A mysterious book floats in the air.

The Grimoire does not speak aloud but you can sense its thoughts. Spells appear slowly, tailored to your curiosity, growing more complex as you grow.

It wants you to become reliant on it, Your thoughts will be altered to fit something the book wants you to become.

You won't be exactly you anymore..

+3 Spells

+0 Rituals

rows.title: The Entity
rows.titleText:
One night, something steps out from the shadows of your own home.

It does not come to soothe you. It does not pity your grief. It lingers because your ruin has stripped something vital away.

Because what you have become no longer pushes it back... what you are is not a human. Which entity have taken an interest in you?

objects.title: Stability
objects.text:
Your money problems are gone. Bills are paid before they are due. Rent, utilities, and necessities are handled by sources that never leave a name behind.

With the pressure gone, you find yourself able to spend more freely. Not recklessly, but comfortably.

+2 Inhumanity

objects.title: Respect
objects.text:
Your presence is no longer overlooked.

You are no longer talked over, interrupted, or quietly dismissed to the side. When you speak, people pause and listen.

Respect for you comes naturally.

You are respected without having to demand it, taken seriously without trying.

+2 Inhumanity

objects.title: Refuse
objects.text:
You refuse the offer.

Not out of virtue, but exhaustion. Whatever you were trying to save no longer feels worth returning to.

The life you lost remains lost, and you allow it to stay that way.

The smartest choice...

-1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Second chance
objects.text:
A door you believed forever closed opens again. An application is reconsidered. A ruined connection resurfaces..

Your past failure is quietly set aside.

You are allowed back in, as though nothing ever went wrong. This time, you can do it properly.

+2 Inhumanity

objects.title: Retribution
objects.text:
Those who wronged you begin to lose what they built. Careers fail, Relationships rot and reputation tanks.

Small failures pile into disasters. Their lives unravel in ways that appear natural.

No one suspects you. No one will ever connects the pattern.

+2 Inhumanity

rows.title: The Offer
rows.titleText:
The entity extends a favor.

If you accept, you will wake to a world that finally moves in your direction.

For the first time since your ruin, hope feels possible. And hope, you will understand, is the most dangerous thing it could give you. In what way does your life change?

objects.title: Infestation
objects.text:
The darkness around you begins to move. Thin, crawling shapes slide across your skin and force their way inside. Ears. Mouth. Beneath your nails. You cannot stop them...

They spread through within you, probing your nerves, until the sensation abruptly ceases and you faint.

You now can call upon magic, but something stirs beneath your skin for a moment.

+1 Ritual

objects.title: Contamination
objects.text:
An unseen force pins you in place as the entity leans close. Your mouth is forced open. It feeds you a piece of itself. Blood, flesh, ink, something that should never be swallowed.

Your body convulses, then grows cold. The sensation spreads through your veins and vanishes by morning.

Magic flows easily now. Each time you use it, that same cold briefly returns.

+1 Spell

objects.title: Inscription
objects.text:
Hands pull you down as they surface from the dark, cold and unyielding. Something sharp carves a symbol into your back, cut with careful intent. The pain is searing that lasts for hours.

The wound soon seals itself, leaving a scar where the sigil was etched. From that night on, magic answers you. Each use causes ripples through the mark.

+1 Ritual

objects.title: Exposure
objects.text:
The entity lunges, clinging to you as it whispers directly into your ears. The words are unknown, yet perfectly understood.

It reveals secrets of the universe to you until you go insane from knowledge, then you go so insane you cycle back into sanity.

The knowledge is gone, but the damage remains. Magic is open to you now. Every use brings a fleeting pain in your head.

+1 Spell

rows.title: The Awakening
rows.titleText:
The offer was never the true purpose of the visit.

The potential was already there...Your life, your ruin, the slow erosion of who you were had worn your mind thin enough to let something else seep through.

Only your subconscious still resisted, clinging to the last fragments of humanity and what is believes as reality.

That resistance will not survive the night.

What happens next cannot be reversed. You are not given magic. You are altered so you can finally perceive what has always existed.

How was your potential awakened?

objects.title: Moth
objects.text:
Witness of the Rot

Inherent: Drawn to darkness more than flame, the moth drifts silently and can remain unnoticed even in open spaces. Its wings shed a fine dust that dulls attention and makes it harder to locate it.

Arcane: The moth naturally settles near corpses or places where spirits remain tethered. Necromancy performed in its presence can call larger count of spirits.

+1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Bat
objects.text:
The Blood Hunter

Inherent: A nocturnal flier built for tight, suffocating spaces. It moves quietly, navigating by sound alone, able to pinpoint movement through darkness by sound. It is fragile, but rarely caught unaware.

Arcane: The bat draw upto 10L of blood from targets and store it within itself. This blood may be used to fuel flesh-based magic, sparing your own body from the cost.

+1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Hound
objects.text:
The Obedient maw

Inherent: A solid, predatory form built for tracking. Its nose can follow a scent across long distances. While it is one of the slower familiars, its bite can tear through wood with unnerving ease making them great guards.

Arcane: Its presence enforces obedience. Summoned beings are more likely to comply with your will, and should any resist, the hound will not hesitate to subdue them.

+1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Cat
objects.text:
The Omen Walker

Inherent: Silent, fast, and unnervingly precise, the cat moves without sound and can cross narrow ledges, wires, and unstable surfaces with ease. It can even see in the dark making it excellent for night scout.

Arcane: The cat absorbs minor misfortune around it, storing it within itself. Over time, the accumulated bad luck can be unleashed on a chosen target with a single bite.

+1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Centipede
objects.text:
The Silent Leech

Inherent: It slips through cracks and gaps with unnatural speed. Normally unseen, it can remain hidden in plain sight but if it allows itself to be noticed, the mere sight of it can send a person spiraling into panic.

Arcane: The centipede carries parasitic magic within it. wrapping around target can embed a faint version into a target, letting you siphon energy at slow rate but its always active.

+1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Raven
objects.text:
The Scholar of the Night

Inherent: Sleek and silent, this avian stalks the skies with bursts of speed that rival city traffic. Its sharp gaze misses nothing, and beneath the midnight feathers lies a keen intellect rare among beasts.

Arcane: The Raven assists its master with spell casting, It can hold upto 5 extra charges that you as its master can access as emergency resource.

+1 Spells

objects.title: Rat
objects.text:
The Survivor of the World

Inherent: Small, quick, and endlessly clever, The rat survives not through strength but through its instinct. It slips and finds exits in impossible spaces, and gnaws through obstacles weaker than wood.

Arcane: When you wield magic, any backlash or negative effect from your own power is redirected to the rat. The rat will suffer so that you may remain comfortable for a small time.

-2 Inhumanity

objects.title: Serpent
objects.text:
The Guide to the Ritual

Inherent: A cold, slithering presence that moves with unnatural speed across almost any surface. Its body lacks venom, but it is alive with perception able to read heat and the faintest vibrations within a 15m radius.

Arcane: When rituals grow complex, the snake becomes your guide. Follow its path, trace along its coils, and the complexity of symbols becomes manageable.

+1 Rituals

objects.title: Imp
objects.text:
The Proxy

Gift: The imp serves as a mobile casting point, carrying and releasing spells at range. Any deal made in its presence becomes binding, enforced by supernatural forces that compels both parties involved.

Curse: It is not loyal to you. It obeys literally.. acts independently, and delights in suffering. Poorly worded commands will have chance to return to harm you.

+1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Grimoire
objects.text:
The Addiction

Gift: The grimoire levitates and obeys you within your presence. While holding it, your spells are strengthened by 120%. Once per week, you may summon it to your hands, fully restored.

Curse: Dependence grows fast. Extended use causes distress when separated, and continued reliance slowly erodes your ability to cast magic without it.

+1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Ancestor
objects.text:
The Remnant

Gift: A dead member of your bloodline haunts you, visible only through reflective surfaces. Once per lunar cycle, it may replace a ritual component with its own essence, bypassing the need for a rare ingredient.

Curse: The ancestor values lineage above all. You instinctively favor family over outsiders, and your magic refuses to harm those of your blood unless they strike first.

+1 Inhumanity

rows.title: The Bound
rows.titleText:
Your magic cannot stabilize on its own.

It spills outward from you, unfocused and volatile, searching for something to hold it in place. A conduit...

Without one, The strain would tear you apart.

The first suitable creature it finds is seized and bound to you, its existence bent to only support yours.

It will live as long as you do. It will change as you change, growing traits meant to serve your needs.

What creature was bound to you?

objects.title: Tethered
objects.text:
Your familiar remains bound close, never straying far away willingly, Operating within 15 meters from you. Its mind is simple but focused, elevated just beyond instinct to understand simple commands.

Executing commands within its ability but without any hesitation and extreme precision.

Such familiars are incapable of betrayal or refusal. They possess little initiative of their own, but within your presence they are flawless servants, acting as extensions of your will rather than beings in their own right.

+1 Rituals

objects.title: Entrusted
objects.text:
Your familiar is given room to think.

It possesses enough intelligence to interpret intent, capable of carrying out complex tasks and taking initiative when left alone without supervision.

It can operate independently up to 150 meters for hours at a time, always finding its way back to you.

Its loyalty is genuine, but not flawless. They may misjudge your desires, overstep boundaries, or take independent actions in an effort to please you.

They will never betray you, but they may fail you. (Grants nothing)

objects.title: Autonomous
objects.text:
Your familiar is no longer an extension of your will.

It can roam up to 1500 meters away for weeks at a time, thinking, planning, adapting.

Its intelligence rivals your own, and it is capable of strategy, deception, and long-term intent.

Such a familiar is not loyalty-bound in the traditional sense. It cannot fully refuse a command, but it can question it, reinterpret it, or execute it in ways that undermine your intent if it deems the order unreasonable.

It is very capable… but its compliance is conditional.

+1 Spells

rows.title: The Agency
rows.titleText:
With a familiar bound to you, its form is decided but its will is not.

Not all companions serve the same way.

Some cling like shadows. Others walk ahead and look back only when they choose.

You must choose how much of itself it is allowed to keep.

How much Agency you grant your Familiar?

objects.title: Telephone
objects.text: Your familiar is capable of speech only when within your presence. This ignores the limits of its anatomy. It may form opinions, and hold conversation as any person would in your native tongue.

objects.title: Return
objects.text: Your familiar cannot be permanently destroyed while you still draw breath. Any injury it suffers will mend on its own within hours. If it is slain outright, It simply manifests near you after 24 hours.

objects.title: Unburdened
objects.text: Your familiar’s body is no longer bound by ordinary biological demands. It does not require sleep, food, or waste elimination and can handle harsh weather. It may still eat, rest, and indulge if it wishes

rows.title: The Core Endowments
rows.titleText:
Whatever answers your magic does not create familiars from nothing.

It merely evolves a nearby creature to suit your needs. While each familiar grows into its own nature, all of them are altered by the same force that claimed you. This alteration leaves marks that are universal, traits that manifest regardless of species or origin.

objects.title: Ghostlight
objects.text:
Your familiar can emit its own light, pale or harsh depending on its nature.

Weaker Supernatural entities recoil from it instinctively, as if they are burned by it.

The light does not harm the mundane.

objects.title: Shadowmeld
objects.text:
Your familiar can dissolve into your shadow, flattening itself into darkness and remaining there unseen and untouchable.

With a thought, you may release it, letting it peel free from the darkness.

objects.title: Truthseeker
objects.text:
Your familiar instinctively senses falsehoods spoken nearby it. Lies cause it to perk up and glare at the liar with hatred.

If it chooses, the liar’s tongue will burn with sudden pain every time they lie,

objects.title: Gravefog
objects.text:
Your familiar can exhale thick, unnatural mist in massive quantities.

The fog spreads rapidly, swallowing streets and structures, dulling sound and sight in a large area within a mere minute.

objects.title: Deathward
objects.text:
While most familiars return from death over the course of a full day.

Your Familiar reforms in a fraction of that time. Within two hours, it will rise again back from its own demise.

objects.title: Farseeing
objects.text: At any moment, you may see through your familiar’s eyes and hear through its ears. Distance does not weaken this connection. Your body remains blind and deaf while borrowed senses are active.

objects.title: Mindline
objects.text:
You and your familiar may communicate through direct thought regardless of distance between you two.

You can fully understand familiar as if its speaking within your mind and vice versa.

objects.title: Ventriloquy
objects.text:
Your familiar can perfectly reproduce any sound it has ever heard with accuracy.

Organic or Mechanical noises, It mimics it all.

Even those familiar with the source will struggle to tell the difference.

objects.title: Masquerade
objects.text:
Your familiar's presence can cause an anti-memetic effect like other supernatural phenomena can on regular humans.

This makes it harder for people to remember seeing your familiar and its abnormal traits.

objects.title: Placeholder
objects.text:
Once every six hours, you may exchange positions with your familiar instantly.

This process may cause dizziness.

You simply appear where it stood, and it appears where you were.

rows.title: The Endowments
rows.titleText:
Binding a familiar is not the end of its transformation. Magic settles into it differently than it does in you, Its trait are meant to be in synergy with your magic. Familiars tend to develop unnatural traits to better serve its master.

Which 2 traits did your familiar develop?

objects.title: Curious
objects.text:
Your familiar wants to understand the world.

It explores when allowed, asks questions when it can.

It studies the world closely, lingering over objects, places, and behaviors you might dismiss without thought. It will test things gently just to see what happens.

It may pick up habits or tricks you never taught it, simply by watching you and the world long enough.

objects.title: Jaded
objects.text:
Your familiar expects the worst and is rarely surprised.

It distrusts strangers, questions motives, and assumes hidden dangers in most encounters.

In matters of magic, it keeps you grounded, pulling you away from reckless hope and emotional traps laid by predatory things. It carries a dry, sharp humor, finding brief amusement in sarcasm and irony.

objects.title: Stern
objects.text:
Your familiar speaks bluntly, sometimes cruelly. It does not soften its words or concern itself with feelings. Foolish ideas are called foolish.

It simply sees no value in lying to you. Such familiars are often skilled at reading others, noticing inconsistencies in alibi and their hidden motives within a few minutes of exposure.

objects.title: Kindred
objects.text:
Your familiar treats you as a friend. It speaks openly, offers its thoughts, and is comfortable disagreeing when it believes you are wrong. Its presence carries warmth, a steady reminder that you are no longer facing things alone.

Violence unsettles it, even when justified.

It prefers calm spaces and small comforts when idle.

objects.title: Regal
objects.text:
Your familiar takes pride in what it is. It carries itself with confidence and makes no effort at all to hide its bond to you from anyone.

It sees itself, and by extension you, as set apart from others, and does not bother pretending otherwise.

It obeys without complaint, but respect is expected. Your well-being comes before its comfort.

objects.title: Pragmatic
objects.text:
Your familiar speaks only when it has something worth saying to your current situation. It observes the environment constantly, looking out for you. When it offers advice, it is practical, often harsh, and focused on minimizing risk. Once ordered, it acts without hesitation and without moral debate.

It understands emotion, but refuses to let it interfere.

objects.title: Attached
objects.text:
Your familiar remains close, often closer than required. It lingers at your side, settles near your shadow, and reacts quickly to shifts in your mood. When idle, it seeks physical proximity when allowed.

It is a possessive concern.

It dislikes when you are hurt or left alone, and grows visibly restless when separated from you for long.

objects.title: Irreverent
objects.text:
Your familiar treats danger as a joke. It cracks jokes under pressure, mocks threats openly, and never fully drops its casual tone.

It teases you when situation allows it.

Even in violence, it finds amusement in it. When things go wrong, it laughs first and adapts second.

Violence does not disturb it, but neither does it glorify it.

rows.title: The Personality
rows.titleText:
Your Familiar is not just a mere pet.

The binding grants it awareness of its own.

It reacts to you, It has its own opinions, and develops habits that are beyond just serving you.

What manner of mind now walks beside you?

[Choose 2 and merge them as you see fit]

objects.title: The Source
objects.text:
The supernatural is not native to this world. It is a side effect. A consequence of something else pressing against reality and bleeding through.

That force is the Other Place.

The Other Place is an endless dimension that overlaps every known reality. It is the realm where dreams form, where imagination originates from.

It reflects the collective subconscious of all living minds across realities.

Since the dawn of time, the boundary in your world has never fully held. The Other Place seeps in, slowly and constantly... Over ages, it has altered the rules of this reality just enough to allow the supernatural to exist.

All Invokers, familiars and supernatural entities are consequences of this abnormal interference.

objects.title: The Change
objects.text:
Supernatural answers to those who loses grip on their reality.

This most often happens through prolonged suffering, isolation, or despair that erodes their sense of self. In this weakened state, the mind becomes receptive to the Other Place, no longer able to keep it at bay.

The Other Place responds.

Its influence settles over the fractured soul, and entities of this realm are drawn to the opening take what remains of the person’s anchors: conviction, self identity, and human dreams.

The body survives. The mind still functions.

But the person they were no longer fully exists.

Something else now occupies the space they left behind, What stands afterward looks human, sounds human, and may even believe it still is.

But it is not.

objects.title: The Invokers
objects.text:
Such beings are no longer human.

They are known as Invokers, those who are capable of drawing fragments of the Other Place into our reality and compelling them to take form as supernatural events for their won benefit.

An Invoker functions as a living faucet to control the leak.

They can regulate the spill they open, deciding how wide to open it and for how long, allowing the influence of the Other Place to pass through as needed.

An Invoker possesses a finite reserve they can draw upon before exhaustion sets in, enforced by the same biological constraints that once made them human. While They are limited by quantity, The energy itself can be used to call upon a multitude of effects.

Gestures, words, and practiced actions serve as triggers to channel the magic.

objects.title: Spell-casting
objects.text:
The most immediate way to invoke the Other Place is to use your own body and mind as the medium. By allowing a controlled portion of the realm to pass through you and binding it to a chosen trigger, you can force brief supernatural effects into existence, Such manifestations are known as spells.

Spells are flexible and fast. They can be deployed with little preparation and have versatility, but their influence is limited. Their effects are localized, temporary, and fade once the flow is cut.

Every spell draws from an internal reserve known as charge. Simple effects fall under light usage and cost little, often half a charge or a single unit.

These are safe and are commonly used in most scenarios.

By committing three or four charges at once, a spell can be forced far beyond its usual limits, producing bursts of power capable of matching or overwhelming many supernatural entities with ease.

objects.title: Ritualism
objects.text:
Rituals abandon the body as the medium entirely.

Instead of filtering the Other Place through themselves, the Invoker prepares the world to receive it directly. Symbols are inscribed, materials arranged, sacrifices are made so that the realm can spill into reality without ripping it apart.

Rituals are slow and demanding. They require precise knowledge, Material preparations and careful execution.

Failure can lead to consequences no power on this world can fix.

When successful, their effects are unmatched. Rituals can alter environments, create autonomous beings, rewrite natural laws or impose lasting changes on reality itself.

They consume no charge from the Invoker, but they demand time, preparation, and a willingness to accept whatever price the process extracts.

Attempting a ritual without proper understanding is one of the fastest ways to leave permanent scars on the reality itself.

objects.title: Low
objects.text:
Your vessel can hold a mere 10 charges at most. It is enough to perform a couple of heavy spells before depletion, but prolonged confrontation will drain you far faster than most. Survival depends as much on cunning as on raw power.

-1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Medium
objects.text:
Your vessel holds up to 25 charges, slightly above the average of most Invokers. You can discharge six heavy spells within a brief span. This makes you capable of confronting most threats, yet reckless bursts may still leave you drained.

+1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Massive
objects.text:
Your vessel is extraordinary, capable of holding up to 50 charges. Few Invokers in the world rival such reserves. You may cast heavy spells with near-reckless abandon.

Yet even this abundance is finite, Dont let overconfidence take hold.

+2 Inhumanity

rows.title: The Reserves
rows.titleText:
The most vital aspect of your abilities is the charge that fuels all spells.

No two Invokers are the same, even when wielding identical techniques... charge capacity varies.

What is your maximum charge capacity?

objects.title: Slow
objects.text:
Your vessel recovers charge at a rate of 1 per hour. This is painfully sluggish.

Once drained, you may remain powerless for long stretches of time, forced to rely on mundane means of defense while your reserves slowly fill back up.

-1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Moderate
objects.text:
Your recovery matches the norm among Invokers, restoring 1 charge every 30 mins.

This allows for measured use of your abilities without constant fear of depletion. While you cannot afford recklessness, you are rarely left helpless unless you overextend yourself.

+1 Inhumanity

objects.title: Fast
objects.text:
Your recovery rate borders on abnormal, restoring 1 charge every 15 mins.

Few Invokers rivals this pace. Your reserves refill quickly enough to sustain frequent spell use, allowing prolonged engagements where others would quickly falter.

+2 Inhumanity

rows.title: The Recovery
rows.titleText:
Once charge is spent, your vessel begins to refill on its own.

A slow draw from the Other Place that seeps back into you over time.

As with capacity, recovery speed varies sharply between Invokers.

What is your rate of recovery?

objects.title: Standard
objects.text:
Your output efficiency aligns with the majority of Invokers. Light spell usage consumes 0.5 charge, occasionally rising to 1 when pushed beyond its usual limits.

Heavy spell usage will consistently cost you 4 of your charges.

+0 Inhumanity

objects.title: Refined
objects.text:
Your control over charge is unusually precise. Light spell use, even when pushed, remains at 0.5 charge. Heavy usage draws only 3 charges instead of the usual 4. The difference seems minor in isolation, but across repeated invocations, it adds up.

+3 Inhumanity

rows.title: The Output
rows.titleText:
Most Invokers exhibit a broadly standardized cost when converting charge into spellwork.

The flow is inefficient by nature, and losses are expected.

Still, a rare few manage to waste less of what they draw

Are You among the Honored ones?

objects.title: Mantra
objects.text:
Power shaped through sound. By speaking a chosen phrase or a word, you align your sound with the Other Place and release its influence into reality.

The words themselves carry no meaning to others, It may not even hold a meaning towards you either.

objects.title: Prana
objects.text:
Power drawn through controlled breath.

You take a deep breath and invoke magic by exhaling with intent, pushing a portion of the Other Place out through your body in a controlled release of your breath. If your intent and exhale are timed correctly, Your spell shall manifest into this world.

objects.title: Mudra
objects.text:
Power invoked through form.

You invoke the Other Place by forming a deliberate configurations with your hands and fingers for all your spells.

Mudras are silent and controlled. They can be executed mid-motion, in combat or concealment, as long as your hands are free.

rows.title: The Trigger
rows.titleText:
Invocation of Other Place is no simple feat. A spell does not respond to intent alone.

It requires its trigger to be performed correctly, every time... so an Invoker doesn't channel it by accident.

Incorrectly performing your trigger has no negative consequences.

How do you trigger your spells?

objects.title: Domain
objects.text:
By executing all three triggers simultaneously, the user may impose their innate domain over the reality within 75-meter radius of them at cost of 2 charges.

Within this space, reality is overwritten by a construct shaped by the user’s inner nature, personality, and unfulfilled aspirations. This space is inherently biased in the user’s favor, violently reinforcing their abilities while resisting hostile influence.

objects.title: Psychic Casting
objects.text:
The user no longer requires external triggers to activate their abilities. Mantra, Mudra, and Prāṇa are internalized, allowing effects to manifest through focused intent alone, manifesting almost instantly within effective range.

Additionally, Now heavy usage of your spells require merely 2.5 unit charges, enabling sustained reckless use of powerful abilities as long as you can endure the mental strain abusing your spells will cause.

objects.title: Shikigami
objects.text:
By expending 3 charges, you may forcibly induce monsterization in your familiar, driving it into an evolved, aberrant state for up to one hour. While transformed, the familiar loses access to all of its original perks but in exchange, it gains overwhelming physical power and manifests a unique spell.

This spell may be cast freely without charge cost, but the familiar’s intellect is significantly diminished.

objects.title: Dual Casting
objects.text:
Where most invokers are limited to a single invocation at a time, You may sustain two invocations simultaneously and release them together as a single action.

The total charge cost is paid in full, but the resulting effect is not a simple dual attack.

The invocations fuse into a compounded phenomenon, producing an overwhelmingly powerful outcome that synergizes regardless of apparent spell compatibility.

rows.title: The Honored
rows.titleText:
By choosing the strongest foundations, you join the other 11 invokers like you at the top of the world.

There is nothing left to add. What you are is already complete, already dangerous.

This distinction comes with a exclusive technique unavailable to others.

To be Honored is to be powerful. To be Honored is to be seen.

To be Honored is to be hunted by all.

objects.title: Lucidity
objects.text:
An Invoker’s mind operates with heightened clarity.

This manifests as improved tactical judgment, quicker responses in combat, and a greater ability to adapt when plans collapse in combat situations.

Outside of conflict, it aids in planning, resource management, and long-term decision making, critical in a world where mistakes are costly. This ensures you will never hesitate when it matters or be unable to prepare a counter attack.

objects.title: Persistence
objects.text:
Your body no longer decides when you stop. You do.

As long as the will to act remains, the body continues to obey regardless of its state, Bleeding does not slow you nor does Broken limbs deny you movement. Persistence does not make you immortal but it does result in you having unnatural lifespan depending on your will, Most can live upto 250 years.

As Long as you survive an encounter, You are guaranteed to make a full recovery within a week.

objects.title: Witness
objects.text:
The Supernatural exerts a memetic effect on the world, Causing ordinary minds to rationalize what they see or refusing to engage with it fully.

Invokers can resist this effect, Allowing them to perceive the true state of the world without rationalizing it.

This resistance extends to a limited protection against mental pressure, fear effects, and memetic influence caused by supernatural forces.

Strong entities can still affect you however.

rows.title: The Gifts
rows.titleText:
As previously mentioned, Invokers are no longer classified as human.

This distinction is not based solely on your ability to wield the supernatural.

Your vessel has acquired three inherent capabilities it was never meant to possess.

Every Invoker manifests them without exception, and they remain active regardless of charge amount or circumstance. Even when compared to invocation itself, these abilities are among an Invoker’s greatest assets.

They are known collectively as Gifts.

rows.title: The invocations
rows.titleText:
Invocations are the act of calling upon the Other Place to force supernatural effects into reality.

This is what separates you from those merely touched by the supernatural.

Others manifest a single anomaly or a narrow curse. You draw directly from the source itself, shaping its influence at will...

rows.title: The Spells
rows.titleText:
The most immediate way to invoke the Other Place is to let it pass through your own body and mind.

Spells are favored for their speed and adaptability, allowing effects to be shaped and deployed with little preparation.

Spells are innate abilities, Meaning you cannot learn new ones beyond what you start with.

No spell is truly identical between invokers.

Even when drawing from the same concept, manifestation varies based on interpretation of user but the raw power stays roughly equivalent.

objects.title: Entropic Touch
objects.text:
This spell allows you to impose decay directly onto reality.

By channeling entropy through your hands, you force whatever you touch to advance toward its inevitable breakdown. The effect requires all five fingers to rest on the target at once for the spell to take hold.

Light: Past Invokers used this spell to rot armors, weapons, ruin machinery, or reduce chariots to brittle ruin within seconds. One user ended pursuits by decaying only the load-bearing joint of a bridge, sending the rest into the river intact. Other simply touched humans and caused them to crumble.

Heavy: When heavily charged, Entropic Touch no longer concerns itself with objects alone. Entire cliff faces have been reduced to dust within seconds. In rarer cases, the spell has been used on abstract concepts such as memories to cause target to forget particular memories.

objects.title: Reanimation
objects.text:
This spell allows you to force motion and purpose back into what has already crossed the line of death. It does not recall the soul that once inhabited the body. Instead, it introduces a crude, artificial spark that puppeteers the vessel from within, Fully obedient but lacking any intellect.

Light: Most Invokers used Reanimation to raise individual corpses as disposable scouts or frontline reinforcements, one charge per body. Because corpses were not always available, many users reinterpreted the spell as reanimating the broken allowing broken machines to run once more.

Heavy: With heavy charge, Past users have raised entire clusters of corpses at once, pulling them from all over the globe, These vessels were reinforced beyond their original limits, moving with unnatural strength. While some created reanimated servants capable of speech and greater intellect.

objects.title: Astral Projection
objects.text:
This spell allows you to separate your consciousness from your physical body and let it wander the world untethered. Your body remains behind in a dormant, suspended state. Only other projected souls and certain higher entities can perceive you while you fly unbound.

Light: Past Invokers relied on this spell for surveillance and infiltration. They slipped through locked rooms, listened to guarded conversations, traced patrol routes, and watched enemies without ever being noticed. Some used it to scout dangerous locations ahead of time or to silently observe allies during operations.

Heavy: When heavily charged, the projected soul becomes far more forceful. In most cases, the spell has been interpreted as intrusion rather than travel. Users forcibly entered living hosts, overriding their will and using their bodies for several minutes at a time. While others could generate powerful E.M disturbances.

objects.title: Mediumship
objects.text:
This spell opens a channel between you and the dead, allowing you to reach across the boundary where spirits settle after death. It simply calls, and whatever answers does so with their will intact, Able to lie if they wish to.

Older spirits are harder to reach and far less patient than fresher ones.

Light: Past Invokers used it to conduct controlled séances, anchoring spirits through objects tied to their lives such as journals, toys to manifest them. It has been used to uncover hidden crimes, locate buried bodies, and expose lies.

Some Invokers refined the spell to sever hostile spiritual attachments too.

Heavy: When heavily charged, Invokers have dragged spirits from centuries past into direct manifestation, Talking to them freely and compelling them to give honest answers. A handful of Invokers interpreted it differently, using it as Psychometry, reliving fragments of obejct's past through touch.

objects.title: Osteomancy
objects.text:
This spell grants control over the structural remnants of life itself. Granting authority over bone and bone-derived matter, you may shape, extract, and command it as long as source is non-living. What you command is not flesh or spirit, but the framework that once held them upright.

Light: Past users drew bone from the ground by forcing trace remnants to reconstitute. This was most often shaped into blades and axes as handheld weapons or volleys of sharpened fragments launched like arrows. Rarer interpretations called bone upward from the earth itself, creating crude barriers.

Heavy: It no longer relies on existing material. Bone is generated outright and shaped on a massive scale. Recorded uses include skeletal arms dozens of meters long tearing up through streets to seize targets, walls of fused bone rising to block entire avenues, and storms of hardened spikes raining from above.

objects.title: Poltergesit
objects.text:
This spell allows you to marshal the restless dead into an unseen force and direct it to your will. Rather than summoning spirits as individuals, you bind them into a collective pressure that answers to your intent, acting upon the physical world without ever fully manifesting as individuals.

Light: At light usage, past Invokers called upon only a small gathering of spirits. This was enough to lift, drag, or hurl objects comparable to what a team of healthy humans could manage, but from a distance of dozens of meters. Doors tore from hinges, furniture easily overturned and people were sent flying.

Heavy: With Heavy charge, Hundreds of spirits answer at once, their combined force capable of lifting houses or folding vehicles into scrap with minor effort. Some Invokers shaped this force precisely, crushing single targets with impossible pressure, while others unleashed it indiscriminately into their surrounding.

rows.title: Necromancy
rows.titleText:
Necromancy is more than the command of the dead. It governs entropy and the lingering spirits of those who have passed.

Spells of this school favor patience and control, rewarding invokers who think ahead rather than strike blindly.

Additionally, Those whose fracture was loss can call out to the dead far better than others.

objects.title: Skinwalker
objects.text:
This spell allows you to overwrite flesh by borrowing biological instructions from other life. By touching a fragment of a creature’s body, living or dead, you gain access to its physical blueprint and may impose their physiology onto yourself or a chosen target for a limited time.

Light: Most Invokers carry animal sample on them. A feather to gain flight of a bird. A wolf’s tooth to gain its frame to hunt or escape. Some turned enemies into harmless animals to end fights without killing. A few favored partial changes, claws to strike, gills along the neck, eyes that see in the dark.

Heavy: Past users have replicated other humans with unsettling accuracy, matching fingerprints, DNA and unconscious habits. Some interpreted the spell literally, by wearing another’s body entirely. A Rare few could replicate supernatural creatures, gaining their physical traits but none of their magic.

objects.title: Red Thesis
objects.text:
This spell allows you to impose meaning onto blood and force reality to obey that interpretation. The effect depends not on what blood is, but on what you understand it to represent at the moment of casting. It only affects existing blood, whether drawn willingly, spilled in violence or taken from another source.

Light: Those who viewed blood as life caused it to rapidly grow plants out of any surface it touches or restore dying organic matter. Others, who saw blood as violence, caused it to corrode surfaces or become a deadly toxin. Some view it as lineage, Forcibly attaching itself to all those touch it and bind them.

Heavy: When heavily charged, Imprint no longer limits itself to subtle effects. Entire areas have been transformed by a small blood amount. Streets overtaken by the effect where blood pooled. One recorded Invoker believed blood to be proof of existence, Anything affected became unnaturally durable.

objects.title: Berserk
objects.text:
This spell forces your body past its natural limits by over flooding it with magic, rewriting its priorities for a short span of time. What improves is not a fixed set. Each Invoker’s body responds differently, favoring attributes they value most in their body, To temporarily achieve a 'superbody'

Light: Most Invokers experience a broad physical uplift with one favored trait rising higher than the rest. Some specialized in one trait, trackers enhancing smell and hearing to inhuman clarity, runners focusing on leg power to leap across rooftops or developing harder skin to survive bullet shots.

Heavy: With heavy charge, A greater boost was observed. trength has reached levels where armored vehicles were lifted and thrown. Speed has carried users faster than traffic, leaving shockwaves in confined spaces. One recorded Invoker boosted their sense of timing so to act as foresight.

objects.title: Haemokinesis
objects.text:
This spell grants you authority over blood once it has left the body that claimed it. Any free blood within your influence answers to your will, flowing and striking as you direct. Any blood under your possession can be freely drawn out. Your own body becomes unusually tolerant to blood loss.

Light: Past users were quite versatile with blood, It has been shaped into whips to disarm or restrain, hardened into blades and blunt weapons for close combat, or spread into flowing waves to shove enemies back. Some formed dense veils of blood to absorb arrows, while others compressed it into high speed bullets.

Heavy: Blood can be generated in vast quantities. Recorded uses include village drowned under a crimson flood, geysers erupting from the ground to tear through structures. One infamous user condensed it into a storm of high-velocity droplets, shredding an entire house until nothing remained.

objects.title: Fleshcrafter
objects.text:
This spell lets you work with organic matter as if it were clay, allowing you to reshape flesh, bone, and muscle. Separate bodies can be merged, altered, or reformed together, provided enough living biomass is available for a limited time. Skilled Invokers have been known to reverse their work without lasting harm.

Light: Past users fused small animals into their own bodies to modify themselves, forming extra limbs, reinforced muscle or claws onto themselves mid-combat. Others treated flesh like pliable clay, closing wounds by pressing torn tissue together and smoothing it back into place.

Heavy: Records describe somehow combining biomass of 5 humans into towering 15m titanic body, piloted from within like living armor. Others pushed the spell in a different direction, permanently grafting inorganic objects into living hosts to grant new limbs, curing the blind or make super soldiers.

objects.title: Genesis
objects.text:
This spell allows you to impose organic life onto the unliving. By transmuting portions of inorganic matter within your influence, you can manifest flesh, organs, and living structures directly onto it. Anything created this way remains linked to you, sharing sensations until the spell ends.

Light: Past Invokers commonly used Genesis for surveillance and control. Eyes were grown on walls to spy on royals, Some made hands appear on walls to restrain or choke targets from afar. Some created mouths to speak from distance. Some created crude golems to serve one command before dying.

Heavy: When heavily charged, Genesis operates on a much larger scale. Hallways have been filled with grasping limbs, rooms converted into stomach-like chambers secreting acid. Some users manifested colossal maws directly from ground to swallow their targets whole in one motion.

rows.title: Carnistry
rows.titleText:
Carnsitry governs the living substance of the world.

This school reshapes the organic into a weapon, a shield, or a tool of survival.

Spells of this school favor direct aggression and brutality, Rewarding ones who take charge of the situation.

Additionally, Those who know the importance of their body are blessed with greater mastery over this school.

objects.title: Shapeshifter
objects.text:
This spell calls forth a bound entity drawn from myths centered on deception and imitation, creatures whose existence revolves around passing as human.. The summoned being excels at Shapeshifting, able to assume convincing human forms and exert a subtle charm over observers, enough to dull their suspicions.

Light: Past Invokers most often summoned entities resembling kitsune, doppelgängers, or succubi, using them to impersonate specific people, provide alibis for themselves, or quietly ruin reputations. the entity relies entirely on disguise and social manipulation, possessing no extra supernatural gifts.

Heavy: When heavily charged, the summoned being gains powers tied to its legend. Kitsune have been seen wielding ghostly fire, vanishing into fox form, or moving with inhuman agility. Succubi-types have influenced minds directly, drained life through sexual acts or make convincing illusions.

objects.title: Sentinel
objects.text:
This spell calls creatures defined by raw strength and endurance. The summoned entities are built to endure punishment and deliver it in return, acting as living shields or instruments of destruction under your command. They are slow to adapt and simple in thought, relying on overwhelming force instead.

Light: Past Invokers commonly summoned golems, living armor, or hellhound-like beasts to serve as front-line protection. Such creatures have torn through trained squads, absorbed gunfire and blades meant for their summoner. Others were used for blunt utility, tearing down walls or clearing debris.

Heavy: When heavily charged, Creatures take on an evolved form. Hellhounds have manifested as multi-headed cerberus forms capable of spewing molten lava, while golems have risen as towering titans. They possess immense destructive power but little restraint, often causing severe collateral damage mindlessly.

objects.title: Construction
objects.text:
This spell allows you to pull matter from the Other Place and force it into temporary, usable form that persists as long as they are actively used with them slowly fading away if abandoned. Only one construct may exist per casting, replacing it requires another charge expenditure.

Light: Most Invokers manifest handheld tools or weapons on demand. Blades, scythes, shields, and blunt instruments are common, often used to catch opponents off guard or adapt mid-fight. Others favored utility, creating keys for locked doors, ropes, clean cloth, or simple tools needed in the moment.

Heavy: Entire structures are possible, Some made safehouses big enough to shelter multiple people. Skilled users replicated simple mechanisms, constructing cranes, lifts, or crude gliders capable of gliding across great distances. Constructs can persist for hours and withstand significant damage before unraveling.

objects.title: Stalker
objects.text:
This spell calls forth entities built for pursuit, surveillance, and psychological pressure. A Stalker is bound to a single target and exists to follow them relentlessly, whether to observe, harass, or strike at the moment you choose. These summons excel at speed and concealment rather than combat.

Light: Past users called creatures such as wendigo, ghouls or arachnid that trailed their targets for a few hours. These entities stayed just out of sight, watching, waiting for isolation before attacking or relaying gathered information back. Some were used purely for surveillance, others for sudden ambushes.

Heavy: Summoned Stalker can persist for several hours and displays far greater intellect, letting it plan and adapt on the fly. Some called headless riders, forcing targets into prolonged chases until exhaustion made capture easy. Others manifested mimics to psychologically torture their targets.

objects.title: Elemental Spirit
objects.text:
This spell allows you to summon a being bound to a fundamental force of the world. The manifested spirit commands its element instinctively, shaping and applying it according to its nature and the summoner’s intent. They are amongst the most powerful summons an invoker can command.

Light: Past users summoned djinn, witches or lesser spirits aligned with the classical four elements, Generating and controlling their element within 25m radius. Most were deployed as frontline forces, while others were used more practically, Fire for cooking, water for cleansing or earth for shelter.

Heavy: Phoenixes, sea serpents, and similar entities have been recorded, each wielding authority over their element across ranges nearing one hundred meters. Some Invokers reached beyond the classical elements, summoning spirits aligned with flora, ice, light or darkness, making them unpredictable.

objects.title: Swarmer
objects.text:
This spell allows you to manifest a collective rather than a single entity. A single invocation produces a swarm, intended to overwhelm through numbers rather than force. The more instances created, the weaker each individual becomes. Swarmers possess no direct offensive ability and fade away after ten minutes.

Light: Past Invokers commonly released dozens of mundane creatures at once. Rats, birds, insects, or livestock were set loose to clog corridors, obscure vision, trip pursuers, or fracture enemy formations through sheer confusion. In confined spaces, this spell proved especially effective.

Heavy: There is no meaningful upper limit to how many instances may manifest at once. One recorded Invoker drowned an entire district in rabbits, Making any movement impossible. Another released a tide of goblins that stripped a fortified castle of valuables in under 20 minutes before vanishing.

rows.title: Summoner
rows.titleText:
Magic born from the fear of betrayal.

Creatures summoned through this school are not mindless tools. Each has its own form, function, and mind defined by the Invoker’s interpretation.

Spells of this school reward foresight and creativity, favoring those who think ahead and think outside the box.

(1 expenditure for one summon, To summon 2 hellhounds, Spend 2 charges)

Additionally, Those who knows the pain of lost trust can enforce greater control over their summons.

objects.title: Voodoo
objects.text:
This spell allows you to affect influence a target through the invisible ties they share with people and possessions. By acting upon something bound to them, you force the effect to travel along those connections and settle on the target instead. The rarer or more meaningful the link, the stronger the effect is.

Light: Past users targeted objects such as childhood keepsakes, clothing or cherished trinkets. Damaging these caused the harm to the owner at a reduced scale. Others learned that people carry far greater resonance, and chose to wound loved ones instead, letting that pain echo back to the true target.

Heavy: Users crafted dolls formed from hair or flesh taken from the target. Any act performed on the doll was replicated exactly, allowing for assassinations, While others puppeteer the target's movement as they wished. A rare few used the link in reverse, whispering knowledge into the doll to transmit it to the owner.

objects.title: Astral Chains
objects.text:
This spell allows you to call strings of fate and bind them into chains that spill from your palms. These chains can be launched and reeled back at will, stretching across 101m. By default they behave as physical constructs, but with sufficient charge they can be allowed to bite into fate itself for a limited time.

Light: Most Invokers used Astral chains as physical tools. They grappled rooftops to swing through cities at high speeds, hooked fleeing targets to drag them back, Use them to restrain a target or lashed at enemies at enemies using chains as whips or by covering their fist with chains to strike harder.

Heavy: When heavily charged, any living being caught by the chains has their fate forcibly altered. Such as condemning the target to a string of calamities, Such as car crashes or getting mauled by a shark in middle of desert. Others inverted the effect, chaining allies and loved ones to fortune instead.

objects.title: Coin Toss
objects.text:
This spell manifests a spectral coin in your hand, forged from compressed probability. When flipped, reality commits to the result of coin toss and exaggerates the side that won violently. It does not create luck from nothing, it magnifies what would have happened anyway, for better or worse.

Light: Before any action, Call the coin and choose a side. If it lands in your favor, the result of that action is sharply amplified by 250%. If it lands against you, the backlash mirrors the benefit in equal measure. Some ignored the gamble entirely and instead hurled the coin, launching it at extreme velocity.

Heavy: Coin can now be launched with power rivaling multiple railguns, carving through city blocks before returning once its momentum ended. Some focused on the gamble itself, tilting the odds to 75% in their favor, keeping the reward intact but dulling the backlash to something survivable.

objects.title: Exchange
objects.text:
This spell allows you to force a swap between two visible objects, states, or effects within your range. By clapping your hands, you seize the strings of fate connecting all things and compel them to trade places of the targets with each other, The trade happens the moment sound of clap starts vibrating through air.

Light: Most Invokers used Exchange as teleportation, swapping positions with enemies, allies or nearby objects to escape, ambush, or disorient. Others applied it to states of being, offloading wounds, fatigue, or poison onto another, leaving themselves restored while the burden was transferred elsewhere.

Heavy: With heavy charge, Exchange can operate on narrative itself. One recorded user committed a public bank robbery, only to swap his role with a nearby police officer at the moment of arrest, causing the officer to be arrested, tried, and imprisoned until the contradiction unraveled days later.

objects.title: Importance
objects.text:
This spell allows you to assign significance to a target and force reality to treat that judgment as fact. Once designated, the world begins to reorganize its priority regarding the target accordingly. The effect normally lasts up to an hour, though extreme interpretations compress its influence into brief moments.

Light: Most Invokers used this spell in one of two ways. Some marked a target as important, drawing eyes towards them on a massive scale without fail. Others suppressed importance entirely, causing guards to overlook intruders or medics to step past the wounded without noticing them.

Heavy: With heavy charge, importance can be applied to abstract ideas. Some forced a target to become the center of causality, causing all harm to redirect towards them. One infamous Invoker designated himself as unimportant to fate, rendering him untouchable by harm for roughly ten seconds at a time.

objects.title: Cutting Deck
objects.text:
This spell manifests 3 spectral cards etched with unfamiliar symbols, suspended and guided by your will. Each card carries a razor edge capable of slicing through matter when launched or directed at close range, moving no faster than what a human throw can achieve.

Light: Most Invokers used Cutting Deck as a direct offensive tool. Cards were thrown to sever limbs or weaken structures by carving into weak points. Some favored utility, slicing locks, cutting escape holes, or threading cards into existing wounds, preventing natural healing by keep cutting it again.

Heavy: Most could manifest entire deck at once, unleashing storms of cuts that reduced streets to ribbons. A rare few pushed the spell further, severing relationships between individuals or cutting off the supply of oxygen. One gambler made it a game, where each card had a different minor effects.

rows.title: Causality
rows.titleText:
Magic that reaches into the unseen machinery of fate and tilts it by force.

Invokers of this school impose their will on probability itself, shaping the fate of others and dragging outcomes toward their desired end.

Spells of this school reward resolve and opportunists. Fate resists being handled by force, It can only be guided.

Additionally, Those who were victims of unluck tend to be ones with greater command over fate itself.

objects.title: Domination
objects.text:
This spell strips away autonomy and replaces it with your will. For its duration, the target’s ability to act according to their will is stripped away from them, their own intent drowned beneath a command they cannot refuse. Invokers and stronger entities possess an innate resistance to this spell.

Light: Most users express Domination as a single spoken command that affects anyone who hears it. “Freeze” has locked entire crowds mid-sprint. “Fall” has forced armed opponents to collapse and release their weapons in unison. “Writhe” causes victims to experience overwhelming pain without visible injury

Heavy: With greater charge, Domination expands beyond simple orders. Past Invokers issued complex commands such as committing organized crimes or lie in their favor. In rarer interpretations, the spell pierced traditional safeguards, allowing one word commands to affect even protected minds.

objects.title: Swarm
objects.text:
This spell allows you to dissolve your own body into a living swarm of insects, carrying out the last conscious intent you held before surrendering yourself to the collective. The swarm embodies pure consumption, chewing through nearly anything in its path before reassembling you a few minutes later.

Light: Past users escaped captivity by flowing through cracks or drainage systems. A few used it as crude travel, dispersing across distance and reforming elsewhere. Damage dealt to the swarm reflects back onto the user, making direct combat risky considering swarm’s size is similar to user’s mass.

Heavy: Users have expanded into swarms far exceeding their original body size, releasing oceans of crawling insects that drowned entire districts, Chewing entire buildings. Some sacrificed sheer numbers in exchange for cohesion, forming intelligent swarms capable of planning routes and avoiding threats.

objects.title: Larceny
objects.text:
This spell allows you to take what belongs to another and assert ownership over it by forcefully displacing it into your possession. The object of desire must be within your line of sight and you must understand what you are stealing well enough to define it in your mind to displace it into your hands.

Light: Most Invokers treated Larceny as a tool of theft. Past users emptied royal vaults by stealing gold bars one by one from across guarded halls. Others stripped enemies bare mid-fight, pulling weapons, armor and tools out of their hands. Some dismantled vehicles or structures by stealing key components.

Heavy: Greater charge allows for even theft of abstract properties, albeit temporarily. Some users stole sight, blinding victims at the worst possible moment. Others stole friction from the ground, causing chaos. One infamous user stole dignity from a royal court, reducing them to sobbing, incoherent figures.

objects.title: Equalizer
objects.text:
This spell enforces violently fairness. Everyone within a certain radius of user is stripped of their defining traits, advantages, and edges. Those traits are pooled, averaged, and then forcibly redistributed back into all affected individuals. For the next 30 minutes, no one stands above the rest.

Light: Most Invokers applied Equaliser to the body and mind. Strength, speed, endurance, IQ, reflexes, all were dragged toward a shared middle ground. A few used it defensively, equalising themselves with superior foes to survive encounters they otherwise had no right to walk away from.

Heavy: Anything that can be argued to be a “trait” becomes vulnerable. Past users equalized spell capacity, charge reserves, and even supernatural gifts, forcing Invokers and monsters to fight on the same footing as novices. Some used it on wealth to quickly make expensive purchases before it wears off.

objects.title: Denial
objects.text:
This spell can halt a process before it can reach its conclusion stealing time from the future and holding it hostage in the present, suspending the moment where “it ends.” Denial only works on things whose end the Invoker can reasonably comprehend, too far away ends simply cannot be touched.

Light: Most users applied it defensively. Bullets, arrows, and shrapnel were stopped in air their end denied long enough for the user to step aside before the outcome could occur. Others used it on the body, denying the end of bleeding or organ failure to buy precious minutes for treatment.

Heavy: With heavy charge, Denial can persist for hours and expand across multiple events. One infamous use involved delaying the detonation of several bombs scattered across a city, Releasing them all at once to wipe it off the map. A dying Invoker denied their own death, stretching their final moments.

objects.title: Blight
objects.text:
This spell introduces a persistent flaw into any medium with multiple instances. Once established, the flaw attempts to maintain and replicate itself using the logic of its host. Blight does not simply destroy but teaches the world how to destroy itself, All known users are to be executed on sight.

Light: Past users induced flaws into machinery that caused weapons to kill their owners, Vehicles that accelerated without stopping. Others targeted consumables, alcohol that compelled the drinker to keep drinking until death. Others applied Blight biologically to cause non-infecting disease in target.

Heavy: The most infamous use resulted in the creation of Yersinia pestis. A single Honored one maintained blight for years, expending all available charge daily to ensure its survival. She eventually died to her own effect. With the spell gone, Intensity faded, but the bacterium had already integrated into natural world.

rows.title: Parasitic
rows.titleText:
This school is concerned with taking what already exists and making it yours.

Invokers of Parasitic magic draw strength from the darker impulses of humanity. As a result, the school carries a heavy stigma even in the modern age.

Spells of this school favor ruthlessness and greed. The will to take everything, even if it ruins others.

Additionally, Those who were robbed themselves are often the greatest robbers themselves.

objects.title: Liminal Transit
objects.text:
Elevators are liminal machines: They exist only to move people between places, never to remain in one. By actualizing that belief onto an active elevator, You may achieve global teleportation to any working elevator of this world.

Ritual:

1) Board a functioning elevator from its lowest accessible floor.

2) Trace the rune Raidho (ᚱ) onto one interior wall using any medium available. 3) Press the button for the top floor and allow the elevator to ascend. Near midpoint, press the button for the nearest floor and step out, then re-enter before the doors close.

4) Let the elevator reach the top floor. Before the doors open, press for the lowest floor while envisioning the building from which you wish to emerge.

5) If performed correctly, the elevator will manifest in the target building, doors opening to the desired location, allowing safe exit.

Failure:

In case of improper execution, The elevator will descend past its lowest floor, accelerating uncontrollably while the cabin temperature rises unbearably. You remain trapped, experiencing the infernal heat until death. You will appear back into the world revived but unconscious in the elevator a few days later.

objects.title: Heaven Fall
objects.text:
You can call down celestial wrath upon a chosen land. The heavens themselves become the instrument, guided through a sigil crafted from the blood of a goat and the ashes of what you hold dear.

Ritual:

1) Combine two parts goat’s blood with one part ashes of a cherished object. Stir exactly 17 times counter-clockwise under the light of dawn or dusk.

2) Seal the mixture and wait 34 hours. It cannot be used before this window. 3) Using a map, draw an eye sigil over the target location. Redraw it repeatedly until your fingers go numb, embedding your intent into the symbol.

4) At night, burn the map with fire. While the flames consume it, chant “Vinash” three times, imbuing the words with genuine hatred or malice.

5) If successful, A meteor descends upon the location that very night. Witnessed minutes before impact, Destroying everything within a 25 km radius.

Failure:

Celestial wrath targets the Invoker instead: Goat heads will erupt through your body, consuming you alive while screaming into your ears. Survival is possible only if you set yourself ablaze in a desperate act of appease the heaven, burning away the goat heads as you endure the flames.

objects.title: Vigil of the Pale Moon
objects.text:
The moon is witnesses to truth of your world, Observing everything without intervention. By offering measured life beneath a full moon, you may borrow their vigilance and purchase absolute truth to a single question.

Ritual:

1) The ritual may only be performed on the night of a full moon, in an open area under moonlight containing dense plant life.

2) For every healthy, unblemished rat sacrificed, you earn one Word. The rats must be clean, well-fed, and killed deliberately by your own hands. 3) Once all sacrifices are complete, arrange the corpses into a circle and pray to the moon while sitting inside the circle.

4) A great owl will descend from the sky. You may ask one yes/no question aloud, constructed only from the words you have paid for.

5) If successful, The Owl will answer in universal, objective truth.

Failure:

The ritual fails if performed on the wrong lunar phase, if any Words are unused or exceeded, if sick or unclean rats are offered, or if the question attempts paradox, loopholes, or deception. Your mind will be forcefully flooded with infinite information until you go into insanity.

objects.title: Eden's Apple
objects.text:
Memories are what your mind believes them to be. By sharing a fruit from the garden denied, You may plant false memories into those who eats it to trust you as their closed relationship.

Ritual:

1) Obtain a seed taken from an apple soaked in your fresh blood for 30 days.

2) Plant the seed in untreated soil and water it daily with a mix of water and your blood for a month, The tree grows unnaturally fast. 3) When the tree bears its first fruit, you must not touch it. Allow the apple to fall naturally to the ground. Soon after, burn the tree entirely, roots included.

4) Coat the apple with ashes of the tree and inject snake venom into it.

5) If the ritual succeeds, anyone who willingly consumes the apple will develop fabricated memories portraying you as someone deeply trusted and emotionally close. The more of the apple eaten, the stronger the bond.

Failure:

Forcing the apple to be eaten, failing to provide fresh blood during growth, or improperly burning the tree will invert the effect. Whoever eats the apple will instead develop an undying hatred for you. They will remember betrayals that never occurred, and will keep acting against you until one of you is gone.

objects.title: False Genesis
objects.text:
To shape a mind is to trespass where gods claim sole dominion. By forming a vessel from earth and granting it motion and reason, You imitate the divine and raise a sentient servant to obey who it is assigned to.

Ritual:

1) At Sunrise, Construct a humanoid vessel from raw earth, Made up of clay, Soil and dirt given a human form according to your will.

2) Place the vessel upright and remain with it from sunset to sunrise, and continue refining its form, defining limbs, and carving a face. 3) At dawn, Cut palm of its master allow their blood to flow onto the its chest.

4) Once the moon rises, Verbally reject every god or higher power you can, You must place yourself above them, claiming sole authorship over the vessel.

5) If successful, the vessel animates within minutes. It will slowly refine its body over days, gaining intelligence and loyalty towards its master.

Failure:

If the ritual falters at any stage, Either from lack of your conviction or from any doubt with rejection of the almighty. The Very god you mocked will posses this vessel and brutally beat you up with all their powers channeling through the vessel you made, Their wrath shall calm within 24 hours.

objects.title: Dead Space
objects.text:
Any abandoned place can be made into a home, if you are willing to love what has already been forgotten. By offering time and genuine care, you and your allies will be repaid with sanctuary beyond physical limits.

Ritual:

1) Locate a structure left uninhabited for no less than five years.

2) For a week, Only you must remain there, Living entirely within it: cooking, bathing, sleeping without leaving its boundaries ever. 3) Clean the place to the best of your ability. As you work, speak to the structure as if it were alive, Telling about yourself through stories and jokes.

4) Each day, destroy one possession of genuine value to you. Before destroying it, explain its meaning aloud and reassure the place of its worth.

5) If successful, Those you permit may enter an astral copy of the structure by stepping inside the place, always maintained in ideal, working condition.

Failure:

If the structure judges your presence as insincere, or exploitative, it will reject you immediately and throw you out at mach 5 velocity. If you fail to return once per week after successful friendship, the place will collapse itself as if committing quiet suicide out of guilt for having trusted you.

objects.title: Fons Lustitiae
objects.text:
Those who are wronged are often denied their justice, Manifest their grief and rage, Call a cleansing tide that judges without mercy. Those untouched by the sin will be spared. Everything else is fed to the water.

Ritual:

1) Select a region you intend to subject to judgment. You must physically traverse the area and scatter sea salt throughout the region by hand.

2) Inside the region, draw Hecate’s Wheel upon the ground, Made using a mixture of blood, tears or hair taken from those who were denied justice. 3) Declare a single, Widely recognized unjust act to be punished.

4) Stand within the wheel and recount the crime and ask for justice, Feel the oppression and grief until you shed a genuine tear onto the sigil.

5) If your intent is true, A Flood is manifested annihilating structures and the sinners, while passing harmlessly around those who did not commit it.

Failure:

If the ritual is attempted for indiscriminate destruction, if your belief in the justice you invoke is hollow, or if the sigil is improperly formed. Water will manifest instantly and violently, drowning everything and everyone within the region and beyond. No exceptions. No mercy.

objects.title: Enchantment
objects.text:
To bind your magic to matter is to extend yourself beyond your body. By weaving your own spell into an object, you may create a conduit capable of reproducing your magic without expending charge.

Ritual:

1) Immerse your object in wisteria-scented incense smoke for 24 hours.
