2) Mix ink with crushed sandalwood, Draw out the runes you see in your mind onto the object. One rune equals one hour of active use. 3) Dip the object into salted water, letting it soak, then force the magic of your chosen spell into the object by repeatedly invoking it.

4) If successful, the runes will glow faintly with magic, and the object will absorb the water completely.

5) The object can now perform an application related to the sepll, Each hour of use fades one rune until none remains and object loses its enchantment.

Failure:

If the object is too fragile, too many runes are carved, or the spell is incompatible with the object’s nature, The object will detonate violently when touched, with the force equivalent to a hand grenade while releasing the spell imbued in an uncontrolled manner.

objects.title: Oath of the Devoured
objects.text:
By offering part of yourself, you may broadcast a psychic signal into the Other Place that is universally understood as the scream one's dying child. Nothing that hears it remains rational. Nothing that answers it can be reasoned.

Ritual:

1) All intended targets must be within a 150m radius of you at the moment the ritual begins. Leaving the radius after initiation does not exempt them.

2) Choose one major body part to sacrifice permanently. 3) Chant loud and properly: “Let there be no victor. Let there be no escape. Let this end here, sealed by our own fate.” All will hear it in their mind.

4) If spoken with genuine intent born of self-sacrifice or uncontrollable rage, a psychic frequency of a child dying is sent into Other place.

5) An Enraged Mother answers, convinced she has heard her child’s final cry. Unleashing unstoppable carnage until half of the original participants are dead.

Failure:

The ritual may only be stopped before the chant is completed by killing the invoker. Once the final line is spoken, interruption is impossible. If the entity is successfully invoked, there is no escape.

The only way the ritual ends is when half of those marked are dead.

rows.title: The Rituals
rows.titleText:
Rituals invoke the Other Place without using the body as a conduit.

Unlike spells, rituals are rigid in form and outcome, with little room for personal interpretation.

Instead..symbols, materials, and sacrifices redirect the strain into the world itself, allowing effects no spell could safely sustain.

Rituals lack the flexibility of spells, but they are not innate.

You may learn or uncover additional rituals beyond this selection, though there is no assurance they will rival the potency of those documented here.

objects.title: Manifestations
objects.text:
The seepage of the Other Place into our realm twists the collective beliefs and emotions of humanity into tangible forms.

Dreams, fears, desires, and superstitions take shape, manifesting as real entities and phenomena that exist alongside us, yet remain just beyond perception of most humans due to their anti-memetic effect.

The supernatural is neither a force of good or evil. Some linger quietly, indifferent to our lives, while others bring harm to our kind. Some manifest as sapient entities driven by the instincts we believe them to possess, While others are phenomenon that happen without any thought.

Their existence is a reminder that reality is only as stable as one's belief in it.

That very belief manifests the supernatural.

objects.title: Masquerade
objects.text:
Only Invokers and an organization known as the Church of the Veil can perceive the true nature of the world, and confront it.

The Church dedicates itself to maintaining the masquerade, keeping the supernatural hidden from humanity. Invokers, in contrast, are wildcards: free to walk any path they choose, so long as they do not shatter the veil.

This fragile balance exists out of necessity.

Should the masses glimpse the horrors that dwell just beyond perception, the collective fear would amplify the supernatural itself.

Even the most powerful of invokers combined would become prey in a world where terror reigns unchallenged, A future where humanity's fears will doom itself. The masquerade is the only shield keeping reality intact.

objects.title: Possession
objects.text:
The one of the most common yet the simplest supernatural activities you can exorcise.

Disembodied spirits often force themselves into vulnerable hosts: children, the sick, the mentally fractured and suppress the original soul.

A possessed human displays strength far beyond their body’s limits and exhibits sadistic behavior, often harming or scaring others for no reason beyond enjoyment. The host endures severe physical and psychological damage, requiring months to recover if they survive.

While weak, They are cunning and as a way to mock your status as an Invoker... Your first possession will not be a stranger. It will be someone you love.

To expel the spirit, you must physically overpower the host and cause sufficient harm and pain onto their body to force the intruder out.

objects.title: Black Calamity
objects.text:
Widespread superstition surrounding black cat occasionally condenses into a living manifestation as a regular cat. Up close, its eyes lack any pupils, pale white voids rests there. Its fur is pitch-black and unnaturally dense, warping the light around it.

Calamity trails the creature like its shadow. Accidents spike, Financial crisis hits households, Minor misunderstandings escalate into violence. Such are the results caused by the mere existence of this entity.

The entity can be neutralized by adopting it. By claiming it as yours, all misfortune redirects exclusively toward you. As the superstition surrounding it weakens, the entity starves, fading over the course of a week.

Remain vigilant. The cat understands what is happening and will attempt to escape back into the wild, where fear can sustain it again.

objects.title: The Murmurer
objects.text:
Born from collective human anxiety and loneliness, the Murmurer appears as a human figure, its face permanently twisted into an uncanny, unnatural smile. It is a solitary predator, stalking a single individual at a time.

It hides in homes: under beds, inside closets, crawling across ceilings, and peering through windows. Its movements defy normal physics, and it possesses an instinctive ability to remain unseen by its target.

The Murmurer invades the mind, whispering insecurities, doubts, and fears. Over time, these whispers amplify, driving the victim toward depression.

The only way to banish it is by helping the victim confront their fears. Genuine mental support, therapy, and acknowledgment of its presence allow the victim to isolate the Murmurer. Once the victim gains control over their own mind, the entity vanishes.

objects.title: Hands of Dartmoor
objects.text:
Ghostly hands erupt from sites marked by repeated accidents or deaths. When a lone human enters such an area, multiple hands emerge from walls, floors, and ceilings, attempting to tear the intruder apart.

These are among the rare supernatural entities that mortals can perceive directly. They can appear at any time, day or night, as long as a solitary human nears their anchor, the central point of the phenomenon.

Each hand possesses roughly twice the strength of a normal human. Attempts to damage them only provoke rapid regeneration, and their strikes accelerate with repeated attacks. Their lack of bones allows extreme elasticity, which they use effectively as whips.

Exorcism requires identifying the anchor point and destroying it by any means. Only then will the hands cease their activity.

objects.title: Wendigo
objects.text:
A winter entity born from humanity’s fear of the wild and the predators that inhabit it. Though labeled as wendigo, these entities do not strictly resemble their folkloric counterparts, Its merely one of their possible forms.

They are capable of assuming numerous forms, commonly animals such as deer, crows, lions, or snakes and a special form that resembles humans themselves.

They are creatures governed entirely by instinct. Their desires are simple: roam, feed, mate. The methods by which they fulfill these desires are indiscriminate and often excessively violent, with no regard for other life.

Physically, a wendigo is extremely powerful. It can breach concrete structures, overturn vehicles, and pursue prey for extended periods without fatigue. Exorcism is difficult but achievable, requiring sustained force and high-output destructive spells.

objects.title: Corridor of Lost Days
objects.text:
Schools accumulate decades of fear: the stress of exams, bullying, social hierarchies, unfulfilled ambitions. To reflect the disorientation and despair of a student lost in their school years, the building develops spatial anomalies that distort reality itself.

At night, and occasionally during the day, corridors shift, classrooms relocate, new floors and rooms appear, All designed to confuse and trap the unwary. Over the past week, six students and one janitor have disappeared, swallowed by the liminal maze.

The school is not truly infinite. Its spatial distortions are massive but bounded. Your objective is to locate the principal’s cabin and destroy the timetable kept on the table, while rescuing any trapped victims you can. The building will actively resist, constantly rearranging itself to impede your progress.

objects.title: The Gardener
objects.text:
Certain enchantments can permanently imbue magical abilities into objects, though at the cost of hundreds of lives. One such object, the Black Bracelet of Hutan, grants regular humans command over nature itself.

The current wielder is a man cut off from society, convinced that crime and evil are the rot of the world and that only he, as its gardener can cleanse it. He punishes those he views as evil with brutal precision, tailoring his methods to satisfy his own sadistic impulses.

He is a dangerous user, able to outsmart, tear down buildings with vines, launch sharp leaves as projectiles, or choke opponents by forcing plants into their lungs using fertilizer spray.

Despite his power, his abilities are limited: his experience in combat against equals isnt high yet, and his control extends no more than 60 meters from his body.

objects.title: Iron Maw
objects.text:
A physical manifestation of humanity’s fear of unstoppable machines and the dread born from the industrial age. It appears as a dense red core with innate magnetic abilities, assimilating metal to form a body, which can grow in size and complexity.

Currently, it has accumulated enough metal to construct an 8m tall frame with six limbs. The body possesses immense strength, capable of throwing buses, and moves at subhuman speeds, reaching up to 165 km/h. The entity is competitive by nature, often chasing vehicles on highways to test and improve its speed.

The simplest method to exorcise is a race: by overtaking Iron Maw in a race, You can hurt its own ego and cause it to shut down. A more direct approach is to tear through its metallic body and destroy the core itself, a far more dangerous and challenging task.

objects.title: Manananggal
objects.text:
A vampiric entity born from fear surrounding childbirth and miscarriages. By day, it appears as a normal woman: charismatic, polite, and socially adept, easily embedding itself into communities without suspicion.

At night, its upper torso separates from the lower half. Vast, bat-like wings tear free, lifting it into the sky while its organs hang under its torso. It hunts pregnant women, feeding on unborn children directly from the womb.

Manananggal is extremely dangerous. It possesses superhuman strength and durability, possess Haemokinesis, and achieves burst flight speeds of up to 180 km/h without acceleration.

Exorcism requires locating the hidden lower half left behind, Sprinkling irritants such as salt or lime juice onto it prevents recombination. When dawn arrives, the separated upper body will burn away under sunlight.

objects.title: Siren of Red Static
objects.text:
An anomalous cell tower has manifested in the region, radiating unnatural frequency into the air, causing variety of effects. The first is the bleeding of electronic devices seeping blood continuously, pooling in streets over time. Simultaneously, radiowaves develop physical mass, exerting increasing gravity around all communication devices, slowly dragging objects toward them. Audio devices broadcast an endless emergency alert for an unknown event, with the volume escalating.

Left unchecked, these effects compound daily. Within twelve days, the combined effect of gravity, noise and blood flow will kill the population. Ordinary humans will be oblivious to their impending doom.

Exorcism requires interrupting the tower’s frequency. Faraday cages, reflective surfaces, and direct internal shutdown are all viable methods. Once the signal is cut, the tower will collapse within an hour.

objects.title: Gashadokuro
objects.text:
Titanic skeletons, reaching 45 meters in height, born from the collective sorrow and rage of the unburied dead. Normally found only in warzones, these creatures manifest after mass death goes unacknowledged. How one appeared here is unknown.

Their size grants immense strength, but their deadliest traits are far more insidious: they are indestructible by any means. They can turn invisible at will, silence their footsteps to ambush prey. Beyond that, they wield osteomancy on their own body.

The only method to end their manifestation is to exhaust their energy. Engage them relentlessly, forcing them to chase, fight, and expend their supernatural abilities. Once their cumulative energy is spent, the Gashadokuro dissipates permanently. Fresh manifestations like this may require weeks to exhaust.

objects.title: Witch of the Trial
objects.text:
Among the many innocents burned during the Salem witch trials, one woman was truly an invoker. As the fire took her body, she completed a ritual that granted immortality, allowing her rage to persist after death.

She now manifests wherever authority and public hysteria are used to unjustly persecute a single individual and causes a rampage. She wields true pyrokinesis, rivaling the output of djinns, capable of incinerating buildings within seconds. She can disperse into ash and reform anywhere within a 100 meter radius, and her flames cannot be extinguished by any natural means.

There are only two ways to end her manifestation. One is to confront her directly and defeat her in combat, a feat difficult even for veteran invokers. The other is to uncover the truth of the case that drew her forth and secure justice for the accused through legitimate authority.

rows.title: Active Supernatural
rows.titleText:
The supernatural is not distant. It is not confined to cursed cities or forgotten ruins. It exists everywhere you go and that includes the places you call your home.

Even when most remain blind, The responsibility to uphold the masquerade still falls on you.

Whether you do it out of duty, fear or naked self-interest makes no difference.

You will be forced to investigate, contain, exorcise, or erase threats before they fester and draw attention from those who must never know.

You will not face all of it at once. Not yet. For now, you begin small.

Select any 4 active supernatural phenomena currently manifesting within your home region. These will be your first investigations or exorcisms.

You will grow and develop new interpretation of your spells the more you are forced to use them, You will learn new rituals from your travels. No challenge is impossible for an Invoker, All you need is proper exposure and drive to go beyond your limits.

objects.title: Veylor
objects.text:
An invoker like you, Veylor joined the Church over four years ago. While Invokers awaken through despair, This young man still chose to wield his powers in service of a world that had been cruel to him.

His familiar is an owl, with whom he shares a telepathic bond. They perceive the world together, coordinating without words. His reflexes react to danger in microseconds, and his intellect as an Invoker makes him the group’s primary strategist.

He wields two formidable spells; Domination and Astral Chain and has quietly collected four powerful rituals.

objects.title: Lucentis
objects.text:
Lucentis is a woman in her early thirties and the group’s unchallenged powerhouse. She wields the Radiant Earrings of Liora, a permanent artifact that grants regular human photokinetic abilities. Within a range of 75 meters, she can manipulate and generate light and render herself intangible for seven seconds at a time.

Her strength is unmatched in the current roster. Her mastery over light allowed her to exorcise a fresh manifestation of Gashadokuro in just four nights, using relentless and overwhelming force to subdue a creature that could have consumed entire districts.

objects.title: Tenebris
objects.text:
A veteran of the church, Tenebris is 40 years old and has long abandoned his human identity, All he once loved was devoured by a rampaging entity.

He bears the god-gifted ability Voidstep, allowing him to enter any shadow and emerge from another. Within darkness, he is nearly omnipresent, appearing across the globe to scout, deliver messages, or silence unruly invokers and whistleblowers alike.

Beyond that, his eyes carry minor telekinetic power. Anything he can see can be influenced by him, Allowing him to choke people with a mere glance.

objects.title: Chrona
objects.text:
The newest member of the roster, She joined just two years ago. Chrona is cheerful and deceptively lighthearted, but her might and innate talent makes her a force to be reckoned with.

Granted Dead Speed by the god of the Church, she can stop time for two seconds, twice per minute. Within that window, her speed is unmatched: able to relocate her allies, travel upto three kilometers, or unleash rapid barrages of attacks before time resumes.

She frequently accompanies Veylor on missions, partly due to admiration that borders on infatuation.

rows.title: Church of the Veil
rows.titleText:
Besides the Invokers, there exists another group capable of perceiving the supernatural and wielding their own innate powers.

This group is known as the Church of the Veil.

They are… peculiar. Unlike the supernatural or even you.

Their power does not stem from the Other Place. Instead, it is said to come from a god whose name, translated for mortal minds, would be 'Chance'

Whatever the truth, their dedication is absolute: the Church exists to maintain the Masquerade at all costs. They distrust invokers like you but wouldn't interfere if you are keep good behavior. But any attempt to expose the supernatural or flaunt your powers to the public will get you hunted like a dog.

These four are the active priests of the Church in your region.

Don't mistake their small number for weakness, Holding the Masquerade over large region requires both cunning and immense power...qualities they possess in full.

objects.text:
Widely regarded as the strongest lifeform, Athena was granted the divine gift “Sisterhood” after solving a red static event all on her own without any supernatural powers. The ability allows her to draw a percentage of the collective physical strength of every woman on Earth, temporarily adding it to her own body. The greater the percentage she draws, the longer the cooldown before she can use the power again. At full output, a single strike is estimated to exceed 826 billion newtons.

Despite this, Athena is known as one of the most compassionate people ever and avoids violence.

objects.title: Cynthia
objects.text: An anomaly within the Church’s ranks. Cynthia’s power does not originate from this world, its called a Twin, a spiritual entity bound to a human counterpart. Twins possess immense supernatural power, often rivaling demigods, and exist solely to protect and assist the person they are bound to. Cynthia herself originates from another world. According to her own account, she longed for a life of action and her Twin responded and transported her to a world where such a life was possible. Information regarding her is extremely limited, and even the Church possesses little knowledge about her twin.

This group is known as the Church of the Veil.

They are… peculiar. Unlike the supernatural or even you.

Their power does not stem from the Other Place. Instead, it is said to come from a god whose name, translated for mortal minds, would be 'Chance'

Whatever the truth, their dedication is absolute: the Church exists to maintain the Masquerade at all costs. They distrust invokers but can tolerate them. But Honored ones are under their radar and as the latest one, Church has allocated extra members in the region to keep you in check.

These six are the active priests of the Church in your region.

Don't mistake their small number for weakness, Holding the Masquerade over large region requires both cunning and immense power...qualities they possess in full.

objects.title: Cleric
objects.text:
Each region is assigned a single individual by the Church of the Veil to serve as its medical authority.

With a touch, they can force regeneration upon any living body, accelerating healing to unnatural speeds. They can bring you back from a mere 5% of the body should you have the determination to live.

Though they serve the Church, a Cleric is not your enemy by default. They treat invokers and civilians alike unless given a reason to refuse.

objects.title: Innate Healing
objects.text:
Though uncommon, some invokers possess bodies that heal on their own without outside aid. Your wounds can mend naturally over time. Cuts can close within hours, and even broken bones can recover within a week.

This has its limits however, It cannot restore lost limbs or repair severe internal damage within a day. If injuries of that scale occur, recovery becomes slow through this path alone. Relying on it means living carefully, because one mistake may leave you crippled for a week.

objects.title: Soil of Panacea
objects.text:
A remnant of a ritual that failed long ago. The temple that once stood there has vanished from history, yet the land itself still carries the aftermath of the ritual.

Anything not connected to the supernatural will die upon setting foot here. For those tied to the Other Place however, the soil grants extreme regeneration. Wounds close rapidly, and even missing limbs can be restored over the course of a full day spent within the grounds.

Do not remain longer than necessary.

rows.title: Your Healing
rows.titleText:
As an invoker, pain and injury rarely stop you. Bones may break, flesh may burn, and blood may flow, yet you will continue to fight so long as your will holds.

but that damage accumulates, and even an invoker cannot walk forever with a hole in their stomach or missing limbs after all.

When the wounds grow too severe, there is only one reliable place to turn to.

objects.title: Lower
objects.text:
You were not exposed to much danger during your first encounters. As a result, your growth from the baseline state remains limited. This is not necessarily a flaw, but it does leave you with fewer advantages.

Your mindset remains as it were. You have no special flexibility than before, So you may have harder time to develop interpretation for spells unless a truly mind-altering event forces you to rethink their nature entirely. Rituals are also harder for you to locate.

objects.title: Standard
objects.text:
Your initial exposure matched what most invokers experience. The danger you faced forced your mind to adapt, sharpening your understanding of your own abilities and forced improvements.

Your mindset is far more flexible than before, Allowing you get creative and hold multiple interpretations of spells that will feel natural to you. Locating rituals is also achievable if you know where to search, though discovery carries no promise of usefulness.

objects.title: Higher
objects.text:
Your awakening involved extreme circumstances. The danger pushed your development far beyond the norm.

Your mind is highly flexible. You dont think outside the box... the box was never there to begin with, You could develop half a dozen interpretations if you work on it. You also possess a strong instinct for locating rituals. With years of travel, you could gather dozens. Many will align with your abilities or interests, even if the ritual itself is not especially powerful.

rows.title: Your Growth
rows.titleText:
The most important stage in an invoker’s life is their first true encounter with the supernatural.

The severity of that encounter shapes what follows. When an invoker is forced to confront extreme danger during their earliest days, their abilities may undergo a secondary development, adapting to the threat they survived. Those thrown into life-threatening situations often emerge changed, their gifts sharpened beyond the usual baseline. Others who awaken under calmer circumstances tend to remain closer to their original state.

What is your growth?

objects.title: Gender Swap
objects.text: You may change your biological sex to the one you desire. The transformation is natural, with minimal physical side effects. The primary challenge lies in mentally adjusting to inhabiting a different body. The new form will not be inherently stronger or weaker than your current one, aside from the typical biological traits associated with that sex.

objects.title: Alternate Familiar
objects.text: If your familiar’s current species does not suit you, it may be changed to another creature of similar size and perceived category as dictated by common folks. For example, a Raven could become an owl, A dog could become a cat or A snake can become another reptile. This modification is purely aesthetic: the familiar’s abilities, bond, and functions remain unchanged.

objects.title: Human Guise
objects.text: By expending one spell charge, your familiar can assume a human form for up to two hours. The appearance they take is shaped by their personality, your perception of them, and your subconscious expectations. The form will include appropriate clothing and features that allow them to blend into society, and the familiar will have no difficulty controlling or moving within this body.

objects.title: Charmer
objects.text: Your appearance and social skills are enhanced to higher degree. You become conventionally attractive to the gender you prefer and your manner of speech gains a natural charm that draws ordinary people toward you. This does not alter your personality nor does it forces people to like you, nor does it influence other invokers or members of the Church of the Veil.

objects.title: Extra Spell
objects.text: The Other Place may grant you the capacity to hold one additional spell within your vessel regardless of your choices. This spell will be weaker than those gained through the natural awakening process. The reduction is noticeable but not severe enough to make the spell useless. It remains a reliable tool, though it will never serve as your strongest option.

objects.title: Extra Ritual
objects.text:
Although rituals can be discovered through exploration, you may begin your journey already knowing one additional ritual. This ritual carries no reduction in quality.

However, because it was not obtained through a proper discovery, its use will feel less natural at first.

Mastery is still possible, but it will require deliberate practice and effort from you.

objects.title: Danger Sense
objects.text:
Most invokers can react to threats within fractions of a second thanks to their accelerated perception. Yours goes a step further. You can sense imminent danger roughly one second before it occurs within your vicinity.

To ordinary people this difference would be negligible. For an invoker, a single second is more than enough time to select the correct spell and begin invoking it.

objects.title: Longevity
objects.text:
Most invokers can live well beyond normal human limits, often reaching two centuries or more. Your lifespan extends far further. You can live for around 500 years with greatly reduced effects of aging, and with effort, possibly endure another century beyond that.

This doesn't ensure a long life, It merely delays the marching of death from simply aging.

rows.title: The Modifications
rows.titleText:
As the lingering effects of the process fade, you are granted a brief moment of influence over your own existence.

During this window, you may impose one-time modifications upon yourself, requesting arbitrary changes that better align with your ideal form, abilities, or nature.

Be aware that they aren't free...

rows.title: Your Humanity…?
rows.titleText:
Invokers draw their power from a realm of infinite possibilities. No vessel can channel such forces without consequence. No matter how disciplined the mind may be, a measure of corruption always seeps in.

The only question is how much your vessel holds.

objects.title: Standard Corruption
objects.text: Your corruption sits exactly where most invokers fall. The mark of the Other Place is present and unmistakable to those trained to sense it. Your inhuman traits manifest exactly as described. Experienced members of the Church can sense your presence if you act carelessly with your spells, but you are not an immediate beacon to them.

objects.title: Deep Corruption
objects.text: Your vessel absorbed a larger amount than most. The connection strengthens your potential and makes your magic easier to use. However, the corruption surrounding you is easier to detect. Those trained to sense the supernatural will feel your presence very easily, and your inhuman traits manifest with stronger intensity.

objects.title: Monster
objects.text: Your vessel took in far too much.. Your body remains intact, but your will no longer holds complete authority over it. Cruel impulses, violent instincts, and inhuman urges now guide your actions. your body moves on its own, acting in ways you would never allow, while you remain trapped inside, forced to watch.

objects.title: Abyssal Eyes
objects.text:
Your eyes possess an unnatural appearance. Their color may fall outside anything seen in nature, or their structure may be visibly altered from a normal human eye.

Unlike most supernatural traits, this change is fully visible to ordinary people. Additionally, Whenever you do invoke magic, occult symbols illuminate within your eyes to make them stand out even more.

objects.title: Everglow
objects.text: A faint colored light constantly surrounds parts of your body. Certain features such as your eyes, patterns on your clothing, or small details of your form perpetually emit a subtle glow even in complete darkness. This phenomenon is visible to ordinary humans. The light is not bright enough to illuminate areas but it is enough to be noticed by others.

objects.title: Tri-Eyes
objects.text: Your forehead bears three eyes arranged vertically rather than horizontally. This grants roughly a 25% improvement in visual capability, including depth perception and peripheral awareness. However, the human mind is not built to process vision this way. Adjusting to such sight runs against natural instinct, and it may take years before your brain fully adapts.

objects.title: Farseer Frame
objects.text: Your neck lengthens to nearly twice its natural size, while your ears grow dramatically, ending in long spear-like tips that are sensitive to sounds. This altered anatomy forces you to rotate your head frequently, often turning it at sharp angles similar to an owl. The behavior appears unsettling or unnatural to most people. Loud noise physically hurts you now.

objects.title: Deadwhite
objects.text: Your skin loses all natural color, turning a cold, lifeless white while the areas around your eyes and mouth darken noticeably. Your bodily functions slow down too. The effect is seen by normal humans at lesser degree. However, prolonged stillness now comes unnaturally easily to you. At times you may remain motionless for minutes without noticing

objects.title: Stray Reflection
objects.text: When standing near reflective surfaces, your image may appear in mirrors that should not logically show you in them. At times your reflection may move slightly out of sync with your real movements, turning its head to face towards any witness. Other people can clearly see these irregularities when looking at the reflection. Moving away from a mirror will end this anomaly.

objects.title: Cruel Delight
objects.text: The sound or sight of things breaking now produces a small surge of pleasure in your mind. Cracking wood, shattered glass, destroyed dreams or torn flesh all trigger the same reaction. The sensation is brief but very vivid, and over time you may catch yourself applying more force than necessary just to break something and get another wave of that addicting rush.

objects.title: Time Drift
objects.text:
Your perception of time becomes inconsistent.

Moments of activity may feel extremely brief while uneventful periods stretch far longer than they should. You may occasionally realize that several minutes have passed while you were certain only seconds had gone by. This will never affect you in combat nor in events that truly matter but anything else is vulnerable.

objects.title: Infernal Horns
objects.text: Two pairs of horn-like growths erupt from the sides of your head, curving into a symmetrical crown that gives you a distinctly demonic silhouette. While ordinary people cannot consciously perceive them, the horns remain fully physical. They make fitting through tight spaces difficult and prevent you from comfortably resting your head. You induce distrust in others.

objects.title: Static Halo
objects.text: A pale loop of energy forms just above your head, creating an angelic silhouette. Ordinary humans cannot see it, but the halo is physically present. Touching it causes sharp, immediate pain to humans. The loop also produces strong magnetic interference causing all electronics brought too close to your head, such as earphones to permanently shut down.

objects.title: Witch Hands
objects.text: The outer portions of your upper limbs gradually darken, turning an unnatural black that darkens toward the fingers, as if the flesh there had been burned without damage to its structure, simply leaving the charred flesh behind. All sensation in the blackened area is lost. You can still move your hands normally, but you will never feel any touch, pain, heat or cold from them.

objects.title: Fivefold Maw
objects.text: Your mouth can split into five separate sections, each lined with its own arrangement of teeth. Your voice carries an eerie echoing effect, as if four faint versions of your words follow behind the original's speech. Your appetite also increases, noticeably causing you to eat multiple times a day, Switching between each mouth for chewing process with no clear reasons.

objects.title: Winged Body
objects.text: Three pairs of wings manifest along your upper body. One pair grows from your back, another behind your head, and the final pair from your sides. The wings are fully physical and come with all the inconveniences their size and shape brings in daily life while forcing religious beliefs into you. They cannot generate true flight, but they can catch air well enough to allow for a slow fall.

objects.title: Darker Self
objects.text: A part of your personality twists in a way your past self would have rejected. One action that your former self considered deeply immoral or repulsive becomes an urge you struggle to suppress now. Those who despised violence may find themselves enjoying it. Those who once avoided addictions may feel drawn toward them repeatedly throughout the day.

objects.title: Aversion Runes
objects.text: Your body is covered in faint runic markings etched into the skin. These symbols remain dormant most of the time, but when you experience strong emotions they ignite with a glow bright enough to reveal you in the dark. Ordinary humans also develop an aversion to your touch. They instinctively avoid prolonged contact with your skin, often pulling away from handshakes or hugs.

objects.title: Veiled Face
objects.text: Your face is permanently hidden beneath unnatural shadows, Making it appear a perpetual black. Ordinary people struggle to remember you properly, If not, They often forget your positives. Forming new relationships becomes difficult, and even old friendships may deteriorate as others remember only unpleasant memories from you.

rows.title: Inhuman Traits
rows.titleText:
As previously mentioned, Invokers are no longer entirely human. Beyond their ability to invoke power from the Other Place, prolonged exposure to it causes gradual physiological and mental changes. The stronger the connection becomes, the more likely an Invoker is to develop inhuman traits.

You must get your inhumanity back to zero, Doing so is the result of your initial corruption and they are the consequence of it.

These traits can make use of anti-memetic effect of supernatural to some degree, Letting you able to continue existence amongst human without them freaking out.

Activating your magic temporarily disrupts the anti-memetic effect, allowing even ordinary humans to perceive them until the invocation ends.

objects.title: Join the Church
objects.text:
Despite everything the world has done to you, you still believe it deserves protection. You choose to use your abilities to maintain the masquerade.

Standing with the Church means standing among powerful allies, but it also means accepting their rules. Your powers must be used with restraint, and harming innocents is never tolerated. As a newly awakened invoker, the priests may view you with suspicion at first. This becomes an official position with a monthly salary, access to resources, and contact with others who understand the hidden world, with weekly missions.

objects.title: Independent Protector
objects.text:
You refuse to place yourself in chains. Your power is your own, and you will decide how it is used. You still choose to protect the world, but on your own terms. You might hunt supernatural threats across your region, intervene in human crimes, or quietly use your abilities to improve the lives of others.

The Church will tolerate your actions as long as the good outweighs the disruption. Still, they will keep a close watch on you. When your methods grow too reckless or threaten the masquerade, They will not hesitate step in to restrain the situation.

objects.title: Traveling Scholar
objects.text:
The world has become far larger than you ever imagined. Hidden phenomena, strange creatures, powers humanity once believed impossible.

You choose to wander. From region to region, country to country, studying the supernatural wherever it manifests. When danger appears you will help where you can, but your true goal is understanding.

You will search for new rituals and document the strange mechanics of the hidden world. Through travel and study you hope to deepen your mastery as an invoker and uncover secrets nobody could.

objects.title: Covenant Seeker
objects.text:
You set out across the world with a different goal in mid. Not to study creatures, but to find others like yourself.

Invokers are scattered across nations, often scattered and keeping to themselves. You intend to change that. By seeking them out, forging alliances, and exchanging knowledge, you hope to create a network that spans the globe. Over time, this network may even become a marketplace of sorts. Enchanted items, rare rituals, and hard-earned knowledge exchanged between invokers who finally have others to rely on.

objects.title: Agent of Chaos
objects.text:
You see no reason to obey the systems built by others. Humanity, the Church, the masquerade. None of it matters..

Your power is yours alone, and you will use it however you wish. One day you might help a stranger simply because you feel like it. The next day you might cause destruction for the same reason. You may even attempt to tear down the masquerade itself, revealing the supernatural world to the public simply to watch what happens next. The Church will not tolerate this, they will begin hunting you. You will have a month head start before the pursuit begins.

rows.title: Future Direction
rows.titleText:
The world is larger than it once was. The veil has lifted, and the things hidden beneath it now stand in full view.

You are no longer a helpless human drifting through this world, You hold power now...

Enough to interfere. Enough to shape outcomes that others cannot.

But maintaining the masquerade is only a duty. It is not a life.

So the question remains...

What direction will you choose?

objects.title: Immortality
objects.text:
Somewhere in the world, hidden beneath layers of secrecy and guarded by strange phenomena and dangerous creatures, lies knowledge that defies the oldest fear of mankind. A ritual exists that can break the limits of mortality.

Finding it will be difficult. Surviving the process may be even harder. The ritual is complex, demanding preparation, precision, and strength of will. Many who attempt such paths do not survive the transformation. The form of that immortality varies. Some invokers simply stop aging. A few abandon humanity entirely and become something supernatural themselves.

objects.title: Worldwalker
objects.text:
During your brief contact with the Other Place, you caught glimpses of other realities. Worlds different from this one...

A world where the corpse of a fallen god created humans who now wield psionic powers. A world where the werebeasts of the night were born from drinking divine blood. A world where spiritual entities command the forces of nature for those who they call their master. A world where humans summon creatures from beyond for their own use. A world where certain people are marked and granted powers like you.

One world is no longer enough for you, You will travel to these worlds.

objects.title: Magnum Opus
objects.text:
Legends speak of a ritual unlike any other. Its location shifts every decade, moved by forces no one fully understands. The ritual itself demands a terrible price. Hundreds of human souls must perish within a single night to open a massive breach to the Other Place. All of that power is then directed toward a single enchantment of unimaginable scale.

The runes carved during the ritual become permanently embedded into the chosen object, transforming it into a self-sustaining artifact. A relic capable of granting supernatural abilities to ordinary humans.

objects.title: Gate of the Other Place
objects.text:
Invokers draw power from the Other Place, yet none truly understand it. Every spell, every ritual, every strange phenomenon is only a small echo of that vast and alien realm.

You want to see it for yourself.

Your aspiration is to find a way to cross the boundary and enter the Other Place directly. Not a fleeting glimpse through a ritual breach, but true passage into the realm that grants invokers their power. No one knows what waits there. The place may not even follow the laws of reality for all you know..

objects.title: Ritual Architect
objects.text:
As you uncover more rituals across the world, a question slowly takes root in your mind. Who created them?

These procedures are too precise to be accidents. Their mechanisms are not random. They draw from the Other Place without collapsing reality around them. Someone, somewhere, understood this system well enough to shape it. You intend to reach that same understanding. Your time will be spent studying how rituals function. How they channel power. How their steps control the chaos of the Other Place. Eventually, you hope to design rituals of your own.

rows.title: Magical Aspiration
rows.titleText:
Even while you walk your chosen path and fulfill your duties as an invoker, it is natural to want something more.

These aspirations are rarely simple. They demand years of research, exploration, experimentation, and careful analysis. Progress is slow. Often frustrating. Each small discovery only chips away at the larger mystery. Some invokers dedicate their entire lives to a single goal.

A few manage to realize it... Some dont.

What will you devote your effort toward? And when the years pass, will you be one of the few who succeed?

backpack.title: The Past
backpack.titleText:
You ascension into an agent of supernatural wasn't made in spur of the moment. Your life, was the perfect amount of tragedy and despair to crumble your psyche.

Just enough to accept the supernatural without resistance.

backpack.title: The Visitor
backpack.titleText: The invitation made by despair of your soul invited something. Something which will shake up the very understanding of your own world. Which entity arrived?

backpack.title: What has been done?
backpack.titleText: The entity came to you with a purpose. Awakening you was the top priority in all cases, but there are chances it may offer an extra deal of sorts. What happened that night?

backpack.title: The Bound
backpack.titleText:
Your familiar is an essential part of your arsenal.. They not only are the anchor to your magic but offer companionship as well

What sort of creature was bonded to you?

backpack.title: The Endowments
backpack.titleText:
Owing to its supernatural origin.

Your familiar has itself a set of strange abilities it uses to serve you. What gift was your familiar endowed with?

backpack.title: The personality
backpack.titleText: Despite the origin, your familiar is not that different from a regular ally. It can think, It can have its own preferences, It is its own person. What sort of person your familiar is?

backpack.title: The Basic aspects
backpack.titleText: The Foundational aspects of how your magic shall work. Are you a regular invoker or you hold special qualities? What is the foundation of your spells?

backpack.title: Spells
backpack.titleText:
The most immediate way to invoke the Other Place is to let it pass through your own body and mind.

Spells are favored for their speed and adaptability, allowing effects to be shaped and deployed with little preparation.

Spells are innate abilities, Meaning you cannot learn new ones beyond what you start with.

backpack.title: Rituals
backpack.titleText:
Rituals invoke the Other Place without using the body as a conduit.

Unlike spells, rituals are rigid in form and outcome, with little room for personal interpretation.

Instead..symbols, materials, and sacrifices redirect the strain into the world itself, allowing effects no spell could safely sustain.

backpack.title: First Exorcisms
backpack.titleText: Every legend starts from somewhere, This is your start. The first supernatural phenomena you will handle, Dependent on the danger of threats, You will grow appropriately should you survive. Higher danger means greater risk of dying but it would make you far more powerful in the long run.

backpack.title: Your Existence
backpack.titleText: Additional modifications granted by the link to Other Place. Your vessel may experience some new changes or perhaps the nature of your own abilities changes to better suit your own desires.

backpack.title: Inhuman Traits
backpack.titleText:
Invokers are not humans.

They are something between humans and the supernatural that haunts them, A being of both world yet belonging to neither.

What is your proof of your inhumanity?

backpack.title: Main goals
backpack.titleText:
What will be your future aspirations now that you've awakened? World is vast land full of opportunities.

What are your two goals?
